extends CharacterBody2D

signal jumped  # emitted once per real jump (the session plays SFX-JUMP; sound never feeds back)

const Tuning = preload("res://features/player/tuning.gd")
const HoseGlow = preload("res://features/player/hose_glow.gd")  # A5: glow material on `sprite`, driven from `hosing`
const JumpPuffDriver = preload("res://features/player/jump_puff_driver.gd")  # A6: a JumpPuff in the level on each `jumped`
var tuning = Tuning.new()
var enabled: bool = false
var tick: int = 0
var last_floor_tick: int = -1000
var jump_request_tick: int = -1000
var opportunity_consumed: bool = false
var require_jump_release: bool = true
var facing: float = 1.0
var rescued: int = 0  # survivors in the rescue bag (set by session; used for drawing)
var bag_types: Array = []  # survivor types riding in the bag, e.g. ["person","dog"] (set by session)
var jumps: int = 0
var test_control: bool = false
var test_axis: float = 0.0
var test_jump_pressed: bool = false
var test_jump_held: bool = false
var test_water_pressed: bool = false  # hose input hook for the scripted route / tests
# Extinguisho art: one static generated image per state, swapped in (visual only; never read by gameplay).
const ART_DIR := "res://art/character/"
const BOX := Vector2(20, 40)   # collision box; feet at the origin (CHARACTER-SHEET, collision option A)
const LAND_TICKS := 20         # landing pose holds this long after real air time (was 8: too fast to see)
const NOZZLE := Vector2(33, -27.5)  # hose nozzle tip in the hose pose (game px, facing right): the water starts here
# Rescue bag center per pose (game px, facing right): on his back at the hip, measured on each image.
const BAG := {"idle": Vector2(-10, -30), "respawn": Vector2(-13, -20), "run": Vector2(-8, -21),
	"jump_crouch": Vector2(-9, -30), "rising": Vector2(-10, -18), "falling": Vector2(-12, -16),
	"landing": Vector2(-8, -20), "hose": Vector2(-10, -19), "grab": Vector2(-10, -27),
	"toss": Vector2(-10, -31), "burned": Vector2(-10, -30), "celebrate": Vector2(-9, -27)}
var pose: String = "idle"
var art: Node2D
var sprite: Sprite2D
var textures := {}
var anchors := {}
var jumped_this_air: bool = false
var air_ticks: int = 0
var land_ticks: int = 0
var was_on_floor: bool = true
var hosing: bool = false        # water is pouring (set by session)
var bag_in_flight: int = 0      # survivors still flying toward the bag (set by session); their heads appear on landing
var action_queue: Array = []    # timed poses that override movement, e.g. [["grab", 15], ["toss", 27]]
var action_cancel_on_move: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Player"
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1
	floor_snap_length = 1.0
	var shape := RectangleShape2D.new()
	shape.size = BOX
	var collider := CollisionShape2D.new()
	collider.shape = shape
	collider.position = Vector2(0, -BOX.y / 2.0)
	add_child(collider)
	var info: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(ART_DIR + "anchors.json"))
	anchors = info.anchors
	for state in anchors:
		textures[state] = load(ART_DIR + state + ".png")
	art = Node2D.new()
	art.show_behind_parent = true  # the code-drawn rescue bag stays on top of the art
	add_child(art)
	sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.centered = false
	art.add_child(sprite)
	show_pose("idle")
	add_child(HoseGlow.new())  # visual only; the driver reads `hosing` and writes the shader's `glow`
	add_child(JumpPuffDriver.new())  # visual only; the driver reads `jumped` and adds a JumpPuff to the level node

# Swap the state image. The anchor (bottom-center of the collision box in texture px)
# lands on the origin; the holder's negative x scale mirrors the art when facing left.
func show_pose(state: String) -> void:
	pose = state
	sprite.texture = textures[state]
	var a: Array = anchors[state]
	sprite.position = -Vector2(a[0], a[1])
	art.scale = Vector2(0.5 * facing, 0.5)
	queue_redraw()  # the bag follows the pose

# Timed state poses (grab, toss, respawn), played in order and held for their tick count.
func play_actions(steps: Array, cancel_on_move: bool = false) -> void:
	action_queue = steps.duplicate(true)
	action_cancel_on_move = cancel_on_move
	show_pose(action_queue[0][0])

func _update_pose() -> void:
	var on_floor := is_on_floor()
	if on_floor:
		if not was_on_floor and air_ticks > 10:
			land_ticks = LAND_TICKS
		air_ticks = 0
		jumped_this_air = false
	else:
		air_ticks += 1
	was_on_floor = on_floor
	if land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not action_queue.is_empty() and action_cancel_on_move and (absf(velocity.x) > 8.0 or not on_floor):
		action_queue.clear()
	if not action_queue.is_empty():
		show_pose(action_queue[0][0])
		action_queue[0][1] -= 1
		if action_queue[0][1] <= 0:
			action_queue.pop_front()
	elif not on_floor:
		# A jump is one flying kick all the way; walking off a ledge is the meditating fall.
		show_pose("rising" if jumped_this_air else "falling")
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		show_pose("landing")
	elif absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		show_pose("run")
	elif hosing:
		show_pose("hose")
	else:
		show_pose("idle")

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	require_jump_release = true
	test_jump_pressed = false
	jumps = 0
	rescued = 0
	bag_types.clear()
	jumped_this_air = false
	air_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	was_on_floor = true
	hosing = false
	bag_in_flight = 0
	play_actions([["respawn", 30]], true)  # snaps into the ready stance; any movement ends it
	queue_redraw()

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not enabled:
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		jumped_this_air = true
		jumped.emit()
	move_and_slide()
	position.x = maxf(position.x, 10.0)
	_update_pose()
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	# The body is the generated art (sprite above). Only the rescue bag is still code-drawn:
	# the art has no bag, and rescued survivors ride in it (person or dog head per rescue).
	# Same drawing as Assignment 1, doubled, placed per pose on his back. Hidden until the
	# first rescue, so the empty bag doesn't cover the generated art.
	if bag_types.is_empty():
		return
	var f := facing                 # +1 right, -1 left
	var c: Vector2 = BAG.get(pose, BAG.idle)
	draw_set_transform(Vector2(c.x * f, c.y), 0.0, Vector2(2.0, 2.0))
	var ink := Color("1b2a3f")      # outline
	var skin := Color("e8b98f")     # face
	var bag_col := Color("e67e22")  # orange rescue duffel
	var bag_dark := Color("b8621b") # bag seam
	draw_rect(Rect2(-4.5, -4.5, 9, 9), ink)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 7), bag_col)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 2), bag_dark)
	# rescued survivors ride in the bag — a clear head per rescue (grows as you save more)
	for i in range(bag_types.size() - bag_in_flight):
		var hx := (-1.0 + float(i) * 4.5) * f
		var hyy := -7.0
		if String(bag_types[i]) == "dog":
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx-3, hyy-1), Vector2(hx-2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # left ear
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(hx+0.5, hyy-1), Vector2(hx+2, hyy-6), Vector2(hx+3, hyy-1)]), Color("6b4420"))  # right ear
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, Color("8a5a2b"))       # dog head
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy + 0.5), 0.9, ink)  # snout/eye
		else:
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx, hyy), 3.2, skin)                 # person head
			draw_rect(Rect2(hx - 3.0, hyy - 3.6, 6.0, 2.2), Color("3a2f1a"))  # hair
			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy), 0.8, ink)        # eye

2	# Jump puff driver (CHANGE-BRIEF A1, A4, Revision 1). Presentation only: it reads player.jumped and
3	# the player's global_position and adds a JumpPuff to the level node. It never writes game state.
4	# Every effect setting lives in res://effects/jump_puff.tscn; this only instances, places and frees.
5	const JumpPuff := preload("res://effects/jump_puff.tscn")

7	func _ready() -> void:
8		name = "JumpPuffDriver"
9		get_parent().jumped.connect(_on_jumped)
10	
11	# A-R3 overlap: every jump adds a new, full puff; earlier puffs are never touched.
12	func _on_jumped() -> void:
13		var player: Node2D = get_parent()
14		var level: Node2D = player.get_parent()                  # WalkerJumpman (A-R6), never the player
15		var puff: Node2D = JumpPuff.instantiate()
16		puff.position = level.to_local(player.global_position)   # A-R1: his feet at the emit
17		var left := [puff.get_child_count()]                     # an Array, so the lambdas below share the count
18		for emitter in puff.get_children():
19			emitter.finished.connect(func():
20				left[0] -= 1
21				if left[0] == 0:
22					puff.queue_free()                            # A-R5: freed when all three have finished
23			)
24		level.add_child(puff)
25		# Revision 1 (A-R8): just before him in the level's child order, so it draws over the level's own
26		# _draw() and behind Extinguisho. Not z_index: below 0 it would also go behind the buildings.
27		level.move_child(puff, player.get_index())

24	var frame_s := 0.0     # one drawn frame in seconds: the "one frame" of A-R5
25	var emits: Array = []  # per player.jumped, in order: {tick, pos, state, live_after}
26	var puffs: Array = []  # per JumpPuff added, in order: {node, id, tick, pos, parent, kids, emitting, finished, freed_tick, freed_state, samples, moved, max_dist}
27	var seen_emits := 0
28	var tree_pauses: Array = []  # [from_tick, to_tick] of each tree pause the test made
29	var max_live := 0
30	var looked := 0        # live-puff samples taken (once per live puff per frame)
31	var moved := 0         # samples where a live puff's root was not where it was made (A-R4)
32	var wrong_parent := 0  # samples where a live puff was not a child of WalkerJumpman (A-R6)
33	var in_front := 0      # samples where a live puff's index was not below the player's (A-R8)
34	
35	func _initialize() -> void:
36		call_deferred("run")
37	
38	func tick() -> int:
39		return Engine.get_physics_frames()
40	
41	# One frame, then one look at every live puff (after this frame's physics, before its _process).
42	func steps(n: int) -> void:
43		for i in range(n):
44			await physics_frame
45			await process_frame
46			sample()
47	
48	# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, as test_keyboard.gd and test_hose_glow.gd.
49	func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
50		var event := InputEventKey.new()
51		event.keycode = code
52		event.physical_keycode = code
53		event.pressed = pressed
54		Input.parse_input_event(event)
55	
56	func tap(code: Key) -> void:
57		key(code, true)
58		await steps(2)
59		key(code, false)
60		await steps(1)
61	
62	func wait_for(cond: Callable, limit: int) -> bool:
63		var n := 0
64		while n < limit and not cond.call():
65			await steps(1)
66			n += 1
67		return cond.call()
68	
69	# One real jump: Space down until the jump is seen (at most 10 frames), then up.
70	func jump() -> bool:
71		var n := emits.size()
72		key(KEY_SPACE, true)
73		await wait_for(func(): return emits.size() > n, 10)
74		key(KEY_SPACE, false)
75		await steps(1)
76		return emits.size() == n + 1
77	
78	# Space as he falls the last 12 px to where he jumped from: inside the 6-tick jump buffer, so the
79	# next jump starts on the landing tick (CHANGE-BRIEF "Jump timing"), 0.8 s after the last.
80	func jump_on_landing() -> bool:
81		var from_y: float = emits.back().pos.y
82		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.velocity.y > 0.0 and game.player.position.y >= from_y - 12.0, 90)
83		return await jump()
84	
85	func check(id: String, condition: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
86		results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if condition else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
87		print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))
88		if not condition:
89			failures += 1
90	
91	# --- watchers: they read, never write ---
92	
93	func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
94		if node.scene_file_path != PUFF_PATH:
95			return
96		var rec := {"node": node, "id": node.get_instance_id(), "tick": tick(), "pos": node.global_position,
97			"parent": node.get_parent(), "kids": [], "emitting": [], "finished": {}, "freed_tick": -1,
98			"freed_state": -1, "samples": 0, "moved": 0, "max_dist": 0.0}
99		for c in node.get_children():
100			rec.kids.append("%s:%s" % [c.name, c.get_class()])
101			rec.emitting.append(c.emitting)
102			c.finished.connect(_on_emitter_finished.bind(rec, String(c.name)))
103		node.tree_exited.connect(_on_puff_exited.bind(rec))
104		puffs.append(rec)
105	
106	func _on_emitter_finished(rec: Dictionary, emitter: String) -> void:
107		rec.finished[emitter] = tick()
108	
109	func _on_puff_exited(rec: Dictionary) -> void:
110		rec.freed_tick = tick()
111		rec.freed_state = game.state if is_instance_valid(game) else -1
112	
113	func _on_jumped() -> void:
114		emits.append({"tick": tick(), "pos": game.player.global_position, "state": game.state, "live_after": -1})
115	
116	func live() -> Array:
117		return puffs.filter(func(r): return r.freed_tick < 0)
118	
119	func sample() -> void:
120		if not is_instance_valid(game):
121			return
122		var alive := live()
123		max_live = maxi(max_live, alive.size())
124		if seen_emits < emits.size():
125			emits.back().live_after = alive.size()   # puffs alive at the end of the jump's physics tick
126			seen_emits = emits.size()
127		var player_index: int = game.player.get_index()
128		for rec in alive:
129			var node: Node2D = rec.node
130			looked += 1
131			rec.samples += 1
132			rec.max_dist = maxf(rec.max_dist, node.global_position.distance_to(game.player.global_position))
133			if node.global_position != rec.pos:
134				moved += 1
135				rec.moved += 1
136			if node.get_parent() != game:
137				wrong_parent += 1
138			if node.get_index() >= player_index:
139				in_front += 1
140	
141	func puffs_in_tree() -> int:
142		var n := 0
143		for node in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
144			if node.scene_file_path == PUFF_PATH:
145				n += 1
146		return n
147	
148	# Seconds of unpaused game time from its jump to its free (tree pauses the test made are taken out).
149	func life(rec: Dictionary) -> float:
150		var ticks: int = rec.freed_tick - rec.tick
151		for p in tree_pauses:
152			ticks -= maxi(0, mini(rec.freed_tick, p[1]) - maxi(rec.tick, p[0]))
153		return ticks * tick_s
154	
155	# A-R5: within LIFE plus one frame; and not before LIFE minus one frame (not cut off).
156	func on_time(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
157		var l := life(rec)
158		return rec.freed_tick >= 0 and l <= LIFE + frame_s + EPS and l >= LIFE - frame_s - EPS
159	
160	# A-R5: all three emitters finished, and the puff was freed in the frame the last one did.
161	func all_finished(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
162		if rec.finished.size() != KIDS.size():
163			return false
164		var last := -1
165		for t in rec.finished.values():
166			last = maxi(last, t)
167		return rec.freed_tick == last
168	
169	# A-R3 "full puff": the scene's three emitters, all emitting when it was added.
170	func full(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
171		return rec.kids == KIDS and rec.emitting == [true, true, true]
172	
173	func timings(rec: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
174		var out := {}
175		for k in rec.finished:
176			out[k] = snappedf((rec.finished[k] - rec.tick) * tick_s, 0.0001)
177		return {"finished_after_s": out, "freed_after_s": snappedf(life(rec), 0.0001), "freed_with_last_finished": all_finished(rec)}
178	
179	func counts() -> Dictionary:
180		return {"state": game.state, "jumped": emits.size(), "puffs_added": puffs.size(), "puffs_in_tree": puffs_in_tree()}
181	
182	func run() -> void:
183		node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
184		tick_s = 1.0 / Engine.physics_ticks_per_second
185		game = Main.instantiate()
186		game.test_mode = true
187		root.add_child(game)
188		game.player.jumped.connect(_on_jumped)
189		await steps(30)
190		frame_s = root.get_process_delta_time()
191	
192		# --- A-R2: nothing on scene load, in MENU, or on start ---
193		check("none-on-load", game.state == Game.State.MENU and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty() and puffs_in_tree() == 0, counts())
194		await tap(KEY_SPACE)
195		await steps(10)
196		check("none-in-menu", game.state == Game.State.MENU and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty(), counts())
197		await tap(KEY_ENTER)
198		await steps(10)
199		check("none-on-start", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.is_on_floor() and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty(), counts())
200	
201		# --- A-R1, A-R4, A-R5, A-R6 and landing: one real jump with D held, so he moves away from it ---
202		key(KEY_D, true)
203		var jumped: bool = await jump()
204		await steps(12)
205		key(KEY_D, false)
206		var landed: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
207		await steps(3)
208		check("none-on-landing", jumped and landed and emits.size() == 1 and puffs.size() == 1, counts())
209		await wait_for(func(): return live().is_empty(), 90)
210		if emits.size() != 1 or puffs.size() != 1:
211			check("one-puff-at-feet", false, counts())
212			return finish()
213		var e: Dictionary = emits[0]
214		var p: Dictionary = puffs[0]
215		check("one-puff-at-feet", p.tick == e.tick and p.pos == e.pos and e.state == Game.State.PLAYING,
216			{"jump_tick": e.tick, "puff_tick": p.tick, "player_at_jump": str(e.pos), "puff_at": str(p.pos), "state_at_jump": e.state})
217		check("parent-is-level", p.parent == game and p.parent != game.player and full(p),
218			{"parent": str(p.parent.name) if is_instance_valid(p.parent) else "", "children": p.kids, "emitting_when_added": p.emitting})
219		check("stays-put", p.samples > 0 and p.moved == 0 and p.max_dist >= 30.0,
220			{"frames_sampled": p.samples, "frames_moved": p.moved, "player_max_distance_px": snappedf(p.max_dist, 0.01), "puff_at": str(p.pos)})
221		var t := timings(p)
222		t.merge({"expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s, "puffs_in_tree": puffs_in_tree()})
223		check("frees-when-finished", all_finished(p) and on_time(p) and puffs_in_tree() == 0, t)
224	
225		# --- A-R3 overlap: four jumps, each Space just before he lands, so each jump starts 0.8 s after
226		# the last on flat ground, inside one 0.9 s puff life ---
227		await steps(10)
228		max_live = 0
229		var i1 := emits.size()
230		var chain_ok: bool = await jump()
231		for k in range(3):
232			if not await jump_on_landing():
233				chain_ok = false
234		await wait_for(func(): return live().is_empty(), 90)
235		if not chain_ok or emits.size() < i1 + 4 or puffs.size() < i1 + 4:
236			check("retrigger-overlap", false, counts())
237			return finish()
238		var gaps: Array = []
239		for k in range(i1 + 1, i1 + 4):
240			gaps.append(snappedf((emits[k].tick - emits[k - 1].tick) * tick_s, 0.0001))
241		var e1: Dictionary = emits[i1]
242		var e2: Dictionary = emits[i1 + 1]
243		var p1: Dictionary = puffs[i1]
244		var p2: Dictionary = puffs[i1 + 1]
245		var gap: float = (e2.tick - e1.tick) * tick_s
246		check("retrigger-overlap", gap < LIFE and e2.live_after == 2 and p1.freed_tick > e2.tick and p1.finished.get("Puff", -1) > e2.tick and p2.id != p1.id and p2.tick == e2.tick and p2.pos == e2.pos and full(p2),
247			{"jump_gap_s": gap, "live_at_jump_2": e2.live_after, "first_freed_after_jump_2_s": (p1.freed_tick - e2.tick) * tick_s, "first_puff_layer_running_at_jump_2": p1.finished.get("Puff", -1) > e2.tick, "second_is_new_instance": p2.id != p1.id, "second_full": full(p2), "second_at": str(p2.pos), "player_at_jump_2": str(e2.pos)})
248		var t1 := timings(p1)
249		var t2 := timings(p2)
250		check("first-not-restarted", all_finished(p1) and on_time(p1) and all_finished(p2) and on_time(p2),
251			{"first": t1, "second": t2, "first_if_restarted_at_jump_2_s": gap + LIFE, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
252		check("max-two-alive", max_live == 2, {"jumps": 4, "jump_gaps_s": gaps, "max_live": max_live})
253	
254		# --- A-R2: walking off a ledge is a fall, not a jump ---
255		var n := puffs.size()
256		var m := emits.size()
257		game.player.position = Vector2(600, 288)   # on the block at x 576-624, top y 288 (first_steps.json)
258		await steps(5)
259		var on_block: bool = game.player.is_on_floor()
260		key(KEY_D, true)
261		var left_floor: bool = await wait_for(func(): return not game.player.is_on_floor(), 60)
262		var air_from := tick()
263		var landed_below: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 60)
264		var air_ticks := tick() - air_from
265		key(KEY_D, false)
266		await steps(10)
267		var c := counts()
268		c.merge({"on_block": on_block, "left_floor": left_floor, "air_ticks": air_ticks, "landed_at": str(game.player.position)})
269		check("none-on-walk-off", on_block and left_floor and landed_below and air_ticks >= 5 and game.player.position.y > 300.0 and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)
270	
271		# --- A-R2 (PAUSED) and A-R7 (Esc): Esc right after a jump; Space while paused adds nothing; the
272		# puff in flight finishes on time while the game stays paused (Esc doesn't pause the tree) ---
273		await jump()
274		var pp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
275		await tap(KEY_ESCAPE)
276		var esc_paused: bool = game.state == Game.State.PAUSED
277		n = puffs.size()
278		m = emits.size()
279		await tap(KEY_SPACE)
280		await steps(5)
281		check("none-while-paused", esc_paused and game.state == Game.State.PAUSED and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, counts())
282		await wait_for(func(): return pp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
283		t = timings(pp)
284		t.merge({"state_when_freed": pp.freed_state, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
285		check("game-pause-puff-finishes", pp.freed_state == Game.State.PAUSED and all_finished(pp) and on_time(pp), t)
286		await tap(KEY_ENTER)
287		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
288		await steps(5)
289	
290		# --- A-R7 (tree): 0.3 s after a jump the tree is paused for 1.5 s: the puff is not freed, not
291		# moved and still visible, and no emitter finishes; afterwards it finishes 0.9 s of unpaused
292		# game time after its jump ---
293		await jump()
294		var tp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
295		await wait_for(func(): return tick() - tp.tick >= 18, 30)
296		var finished_before: int = tp.finished.size()
297		var player_at: Vector2 = game.player.position
298		paused = true
299		var from := tick()
300		await steps(90)
301		var held: bool = tp.freed_tick < 0 and is_instance_valid(tp.node) and tp.node.is_inside_tree() and tp.node.is_visible_in_tree() and tp.node.global_position == tp.pos and tp.finished.size() == finished_before and game.player.position == player_at
302		var finished_during: int = tp.finished.size() - finished_before
303		paused = false
304		tree_pauses.append([from, tick()])
305		check("tree-pause-freezes", held,
306			{"paused_s": (tick() - from) * tick_s, "paused_at_s_after_jump": (from - tp.tick) * tick_s, "freed": tp.freed_tick >= 0, "visible": tp.node.is_visible_in_tree() if is_instance_valid(tp.node) else false, "emitters_finished_before_pause": finished_before, "emitters_finished_while_paused": finished_during, "player_moved": game.player.position != player_at})
307		await wait_for(func(): return tp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
308		t = timings(tp)
309		t.merge({"wall_s_including_pause": (tp.freed_tick - tp.tick) * tick_s, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
310		check("tree-pause-resumes", all_finished(tp) and on_time(tp), t)
311		await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
312		await steps(5)
313	
314		# --- A-R2 (R) and A-R6: R 0.2 s after a jump away from the spawn point; no new puff, and the puff
315		# in flight stays in the level where it was made and finishes on time ---
316		await jump()
317		var rp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
318		await wait_for(func(): return tick() - rp.tick >= 12, 30)
319		n = puffs.size()
320		m = emits.size()
321		await tap(KEY_R)
322		var at_spawn: bool = game.player.position.distance_to(SPAWN) < 1.0
323		c = counts()
324		c.merge({"player_at": str(game.player.position)})
325		check("none-on-restart", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and at_spawn and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)
326		var after_r: bool = rp.freed_tick < 0 and rp.node.get_parent() == game and rp.node.global_position == rp.pos
327		var apart: float = rp.pos.distance_to(game.player.global_position)
328		await wait_for(func(): return rp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
329		t = timings(rp)
330		t.merge({"alive_in_level_after_R": after_r, "puff_at": str(rp.pos), "player_after_R": str(game.player.position), "apart_px": snappedf(apart, 0.01), "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
331		check("restart-mid-puff", after_r and apart > 100.0 and rp.moved == 0 and all_finished(rp) and on_time(rp), t)
332	
333		# --- A-R2 (DYING): into the street spike fire, Space during the 2.0 s hold, then the restart ---
334		n = puffs.size()
335		m = emits.size()
336		game.player.position = Vector2(330, 310)   # in the spike fire at x 320-344 (as test_keyboard.gd)
337		var died: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.DYING, 10)
338		await tap(KEY_SPACE)
339		var still_dying: bool = game.state == Game.State.DYING
340		var back: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.PLAYING, 150)
341		await steps(10)
342		c = counts()
343		c.merge({"died": died, "space_while_dying": still_dying, "restarted": back})
344		check("none-while-dying", died and still_dying and back and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)
345	
346		# --- A-R2 (COMPLETE): entered through the session's own resolve_contacts, as test_keyboard.gd
347		# does; finishing the real route would need both rescues ---
348		n = puffs.size()
349		m = emits.size()
350		game.resolve_contacts(false, true)
351		await tap(KEY_SPACE)
352		await steps(10)
353		check("none-when-complete", game.state == Game.State.COMPLETE and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, counts())
354	
355		# --- A-R1, A-R4, A-R5, A-R8 over the whole run ---
356		var mismatched: Array = []
357		var lives: Array = []
358		for i in range(mini(emits.size(), puffs.size())):
359			var ei: Dictionary = emits[i]
360			var ri: Dictionary = puffs[i]
361			lives.append(snappedf(life(ri), 0.0001))
362			if ri.tick != ei.tick or ri.pos != ei.pos or ei.state != Game.State.PLAYING or not full(ri) or not all_finished(ri) or not on_time(ri):
363				mismatched.append(i)
364		check("every-jump-one-puff", emits.size() == puffs.size() and emits.size() > 0 and mismatched.is_empty() and puffs_in_tree() == 0,
365			{"jumped": emits.size(), "puffs_added": puffs.size(), "mismatched": mismatched, "lives_s": lives, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s, "puffs_in_tree_at_end": puffs_in_tree()})
366		var unsampled := puffs.filter(func(r): return r.samples == 0).size()
367		check("always-behind-player", looked > 0 and unsampled == 0 and in_front == 0 and wrong_parent == 0,
368			{"live_puff_samples": looked, "puffs_never_sampled": unsampled, "index_not_below_player": in_front, "not_child_of_level": wrong_parent, "player_index": game.player.get_index()})
369		check("never-moved", looked > 0 and moved == 0, {"live_puff_samples": looked, "samples_moved": moved})
370		finish()
371	
372	func finish() -> void:
373		print("JUMP PUFF STATE: %d checks / %d failures (physics tick %.6f s, frame %.6f s)" % [results.size(), failures, tick_s, frame_s])
374		game.queue_free()
375		await process_frame
376		quit(1 if failures else 0)

extends SceneTree
# A6 Effect A, jump puff (CHANGE-BRIEF A4, Revision 1 A-R8): the driver's rules, headless.
# Every jump is a real Space key through Godot Input in the real game loop (res://game/main.tscn);
# the test never calls the driver. It only watches: SceneTree.node_added for a JumpPuff added
# anywhere in the tree, each emitter's `finished`, each puff's tree_exited, and its own connection to
# player.jumped, which records the tick and his feet at every emit.
# Setup the test does itself, as test_game.gd / test_keyboard.gd do: it moves the player onto the
# block at (600, 288) for the walk-off and into the street spike fire for DYING, enters COMPLETE
# through session.resolve_contacts(false, true), and sets the tree pause (the game never does).
# Run: scripts/run-test.sh test_jump_puff_state.gd 60
# What this cannot see: pixels or particle positions. Headless Godot draws nothing (CLAUDE.md,
# Headless facts); the look, the draw order on screen and the frozen frame are eye checks.
const Main = preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
const PUFF_PATH := "res://effects/jump_puff.tscn"
const KIDS := ["Flash:CPUParticles2D", "Puff:CPUParticles2D", "Specks:CPUParticles2D"]
const LIFE := 0.9      # A-R5: freed within 0.9 s (+ one frame) of its jump; the Puff layer's lifetime
const EPS := 1e-6
const SPAWN := Vector2(64, 320)
var game: Node2D
var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
var failures := 0
var tick_s := 0.0      # one physics tick in seconds
var frame_s := 0.0     # one drawn frame in seconds: the "one frame" of A-R5
var emits: Array = []  # per player.jumped, in order: {tick, pos, state, live_after}
var puffs: Array = []  # per JumpPuff added, in order: {node, id, tick, pos, parent, kids, emitting, finished, freed_tick, freed_state, samples, moved, max_dist}
var seen_emits := 0
var tree_pauses: Array = []  # [from_tick, to_tick] of each tree pause the test made
var max_live := 0
var looked := 0        # live-puff samples taken (once per live puff per frame)
var moved := 0         # samples where a live puff's root was not where it was made (A-R4)
var wrong_parent := 0  # samples where a live puff was not a child of WalkerJumpman (A-R6)
var in_front := 0      # samples where a live puff's index was not below the player's (A-R8)

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func tick() -> int:
	return Engine.get_physics_frames()

# One frame, then one look at every live puff (after this frame's physics, before its _process).
func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame
		sample()

# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, as test_keyboard.gd and test_hose_glow.gd.
func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func tap(code: Key) -> void:
	key(code, true)
	await steps(2)
	key(code, false)
	await steps(1)

func wait_for(cond: Callable, limit: int) -> bool:
	var n := 0
	while n < limit and not cond.call():
		await steps(1)
		n += 1
	return cond.call()

# One real jump: Space down until the jump is seen (at most 10 frames), then up.
func jump() -> bool:
	var n := emits.size()
	key(KEY_SPACE, true)
	await wait_for(func(): return emits.size() > n, 10)
	key(KEY_SPACE, false)
	await steps(1)
	return emits.size() == n + 1

# Space as he falls the last 12 px to where he jumped from: inside the 6-tick jump buffer, so the
# next jump starts on the landing tick (CHANGE-BRIEF "Jump timing"), 0.8 s after the last.
func jump_on_landing() -> bool:
	var from_y: float = emits.back().pos.y
	await wait_for(func(): return game.player.velocity.y > 0.0 and game.player.position.y >= from_y - 12.0, 90)
	return await jump()

func check(id: String, condition: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
	results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if condition else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
	print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))
	if not condition:
		failures += 1

# --- watchers: they read, never write ---

func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
	if node.scene_file_path != PUFF_PATH:
		return
	var rec := {"node": node, "id": node.get_instance_id(), "tick": tick(), "pos": node.global_position,
		"parent": node.get_parent(), "kids": [], "emitting": [], "finished": {}, "freed_tick": -1,
		"freed_state": -1, "samples": 0, "moved": 0, "max_dist": 0.0}
	for c in node.get_children():
		rec.kids.append("%s:%s" % [c.name, c.get_class()])
		rec.emitting.append(c.emitting)
		c.finished.connect(_on_emitter_finished.bind(rec, String(c.name)))
	node.tree_exited.connect(_on_puff_exited.bind(rec))
	puffs.append(rec)

func _on_emitter_finished(rec: Dictionary, emitter: String) -> void:
	rec.finished[emitter] = tick()

func _on_puff_exited(rec: Dictionary) -> void:
	rec.freed_tick = tick()
	rec.freed_state = game.state if is_instance_valid(game) else -1

func _on_jumped() -> void:
	emits.append({"tick": tick(), "pos": game.player.global_position, "state": game.state, "live_after": -1})

func live() -> Array:
	return puffs.filter(func(r): return r.freed_tick < 0)

func sample() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(game):
		return
	var alive := live()
	max_live = maxi(max_live, alive.size())
	if seen_emits < emits.size():
		emits.back().live_after = alive.size()   # puffs alive at the end of the jump's physics tick
		seen_emits = emits.size()
	var player_index: int = game.player.get_index()
	for rec in alive:
		var node: Node2D = rec.node
		looked += 1
		rec.samples += 1
		rec.max_dist = maxf(rec.max_dist, node.global_position.distance_to(game.player.global_position))
		if node.global_position != rec.pos:
			moved += 1
			rec.moved += 1
		if node.get_parent() != game:
			wrong_parent += 1
		if node.get_index() >= player_index:
			in_front += 1

func puffs_in_tree() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for node in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
		if node.scene_file_path == PUFF_PATH:
			n += 1
	return n

# Seconds of unpaused game time from its jump to its free (tree pauses the test made are taken out).
func life(rec: Dictionary) -> float:
	var ticks: int = rec.freed_tick - rec.tick
	for p in tree_pauses:
		ticks -= maxi(0, mini(rec.freed_tick, p[1]) - maxi(rec.tick, p[0]))
	return ticks * tick_s

# A-R5: within LIFE plus one frame; and not before LIFE minus one frame (not cut off).
func on_time(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var l := life(rec)
	return rec.freed_tick >= 0 and l <= LIFE + frame_s + EPS and l >= LIFE - frame_s - EPS

# A-R5: all three emitters finished, and the puff was freed in the frame the last one did.
func all_finished(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
	if rec.finished.size() != KIDS.size():
		return false
	var last := -1
	for t in rec.finished.values():
		last = maxi(last, t)
	return rec.freed_tick == last

# A-R3 "full puff": the scene's three emitters, all emitting when it was added.
func full(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
	return rec.kids == KIDS and rec.emitting == [true, true, true]

func timings(rec: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	var out := {}
	for k in rec.finished:
		out[k] = snappedf((rec.finished[k] - rec.tick) * tick_s, 0.0001)
	return {"finished_after_s": out, "freed_after_s": snappedf(life(rec), 0.0001), "freed_with_last_finished": all_finished(rec)}

func counts() -> Dictionary:
	return {"state": game.state, "jumped": emits.size(), "puffs_added": puffs.size(), "puffs_in_tree": puffs_in_tree()}

func run() -> void:
	node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
	tick_s = 1.0 / Engine.physics_ticks_per_second
	game = Main.instantiate()
	game.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(game)
	game.player.jumped.connect(_on_jumped)
	await steps(30)
	frame_s = root.get_process_delta_time()

	# --- A-R2: nothing on scene load, in MENU, or on start ---
	check("none-on-load", game.state == Game.State.MENU and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty() and puffs_in_tree() == 0, counts())
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	await steps(10)
	check("none-in-menu", game.state == Game.State.MENU and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty(), counts())
	await tap(KEY_ENTER)
	await steps(10)
	check("none-on-start", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.is_on_floor() and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty(), counts())

	# --- A-R1, A-R4, A-R5, A-R6 and landing: one real jump with D held, so he moves away from it ---
	key(KEY_D, true)
	var jumped: bool = await jump()
	await steps(12)
	key(KEY_D, false)
	var landed: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
	await steps(3)
	check("none-on-landing", jumped and landed and emits.size() == 1 and puffs.size() == 1, counts())
	await wait_for(func(): return live().is_empty(), 90)
	if emits.size() != 1 or puffs.size() != 1:
		check("one-puff-at-feet", false, counts())
		return finish()
	var e: Dictionary = emits[0]
	var p: Dictionary = puffs[0]
	check("one-puff-at-feet", p.tick == e.tick and p.pos == e.pos and e.state == Game.State.PLAYING,
		{"jump_tick": e.tick, "puff_tick": p.tick, "player_at_jump": str(e.pos), "puff_at": str(p.pos), "state_at_jump": e.state})
	check("parent-is-level", p.parent == game and p.parent != game.player and full(p),
		{"parent": str(p.parent.name) if is_instance_valid(p.parent) else "", "children": p.kids, "emitting_when_added": p.emitting})
	check("stays-put", p.samples > 0 and p.moved == 0 and p.max_dist >= 30.0,
		{"frames_sampled": p.samples, "frames_moved": p.moved, "player_max_distance_px": snappedf(p.max_dist, 0.01), "puff_at": str(p.pos)})
	var t := timings(p)
	t.merge({"expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s, "puffs_in_tree": puffs_in_tree()})
	check("frees-when-finished", all_finished(p) and on_time(p) and puffs_in_tree() == 0, t)

	# --- A-R3 overlap: four jumps, each Space just before he lands, so each jump starts 0.8 s after
	# the last on flat ground, inside one 0.9 s puff life ---
	await steps(10)
	max_live = 0
	var i1 := emits.size()
	var chain_ok: bool = await jump()
	for k in range(3):
		if not await jump_on_landing():
			chain_ok = false
	await wait_for(func(): return live().is_empty(), 90)
	if not chain_ok or emits.size() < i1 + 4 or puffs.size() < i1 + 4:
		check("retrigger-overlap", false, counts())
		return finish()
	var gaps: Array = []
	for k in range(i1 + 1, i1 + 4):
		gaps.append(snappedf((emits[k].tick - emits[k - 1].tick) * tick_s, 0.0001))
	var e1: Dictionary = emits[i1]
	var e2: Dictionary = emits[i1 + 1]
	var p1: Dictionary = puffs[i1]
	var p2: Dictionary = puffs[i1 + 1]
	var gap: float = (e2.tick - e1.tick) * tick_s
	check("retrigger-overlap", gap < LIFE and e2.live_after == 2 and p1.freed_tick > e2.tick and p1.finished.get("Puff", -1) > e2.tick and p2.id != p1.id and p2.tick == e2.tick and p2.pos == e2.pos and full(p2),
		{"jump_gap_s": gap, "live_at_jump_2": e2.live_after, "first_freed_after_jump_2_s": (p1.freed_tick - e2.tick) * tick_s, "first_puff_layer_running_at_jump_2": p1.finished.get("Puff", -1) > e2.tick, "second_is_new_instance": p2.id != p1.id, "second_full": full(p2), "second_at": str(p2.pos), "player_at_jump_2": str(e2.pos)})
	var t1 := timings(p1)
	var t2 := timings(p2)
	check("first-not-restarted", all_finished(p1) and on_time(p1) and all_finished(p2) and on_time(p2),
		{"first": t1, "second": t2, "first_if_restarted_at_jump_2_s": gap + LIFE, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
	check("max-two-alive", max_live == 2, {"jumps": 4, "jump_gaps_s": gaps, "max_live": max_live})

	# --- A-R2: walking off a ledge is a fall, not a jump ---
	var n := puffs.size()
	var m := emits.size()
	game.player.position = Vector2(600, 288)   # on the block at x 576-624, top y 288 (first_steps.json)
	await steps(5)
	var on_block: bool = game.player.is_on_floor()
	key(KEY_D, true)
	var left_floor: bool = await wait_for(func(): return not game.player.is_on_floor(), 60)
	var air_from := tick()
	var landed_below: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 60)
	var air_ticks := tick() - air_from
	key(KEY_D, false)
	await steps(10)
	var c := counts()
	c.merge({"on_block": on_block, "left_floor": left_floor, "air_ticks": air_ticks, "landed_at": str(game.player.position)})
	check("none-on-walk-off", on_block and left_floor and landed_below and air_ticks >= 5 and game.player.position.y > 300.0 and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)

	# --- A-R2 (PAUSED) and A-R7 (Esc): Esc right after a jump; Space while paused adds nothing; the
	# puff in flight finishes on time while the game stays paused (Esc doesn't pause the tree) ---
	await jump()
	var pp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
	await tap(KEY_ESCAPE)
	var esc_paused: bool = game.state == Game.State.PAUSED
	n = puffs.size()
	m = emits.size()
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	await steps(5)
	check("none-while-paused", esc_paused and game.state == Game.State.PAUSED and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, counts())
	await wait_for(func(): return pp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
	t = timings(pp)
	t.merge({"state_when_freed": pp.freed_state, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
	check("game-pause-puff-finishes", pp.freed_state == Game.State.PAUSED and all_finished(pp) and on_time(pp), t)
	await tap(KEY_ENTER)
	await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
	await steps(5)

	# --- A-R7 (tree): 0.3 s after a jump the tree is paused for 1.5 s: the puff is not freed, not
	# moved and still visible, and no emitter finishes; afterwards it finishes 0.9 s of unpaused
	# game time after its jump ---
	await jump()
	var tp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
	await wait_for(func(): return tick() - tp.tick >= 18, 30)
	var finished_before: int = tp.finished.size()
	var player_at: Vector2 = game.player.position
	paused = true
	var from := tick()
	await steps(90)
	var held: bool = tp.freed_tick < 0 and is_instance_valid(tp.node) and tp.node.is_inside_tree() and tp.node.is_visible_in_tree() and tp.node.global_position == tp.pos and tp.finished.size() == finished_before and game.player.position == player_at
	var finished_during: int = tp.finished.size() - finished_before
	paused = false
	tree_pauses.append([from, tick()])
	check("tree-pause-freezes", held,
		{"paused_s": (tick() - from) * tick_s, "paused_at_s_after_jump": (from - tp.tick) * tick_s, "freed": tp.freed_tick >= 0, "visible": tp.node.is_visible_in_tree() if is_instance_valid(tp.node) else false, "emitters_finished_before_pause": finished_before, "emitters_finished_while_paused": finished_during, "player_moved": game.player.position != player_at})
	await wait_for(func(): return tp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
	t = timings(tp)
	t.merge({"wall_s_including_pause": (tp.freed_tick - tp.tick) * tick_s, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
	check("tree-pause-resumes", all_finished(tp) and on_time(tp), t)
	await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
	await steps(5)

	# --- A-R2 (R) and A-R6: R 0.2 s after a jump away from the spawn point; no new puff, and the puff
	# in flight stays in the level where it was made and finishes on time ---
	await jump()
	var rp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
	await wait_for(func(): return tick() - rp.tick >= 12, 30)
	n = puffs.size()
	m = emits.size()
	await tap(KEY_R)
	var at_spawn: bool = game.player.position.distance_to(SPAWN) < 1.0
	c = counts()
	c.merge({"player_at": str(game.player.position)})
	check("none-on-restart", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and at_spawn and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)
	var after_r: bool = rp.freed_tick < 0 and rp.node.get_parent() == game and rp.node.global_position == rp.pos
	var apart: float = rp.pos.distance_to(game.player.global_position)
	await wait_for(func(): return rp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
	t = timings(rp)
	t.merge({"alive_in_level_after_R": after_r, "puff_at": str(rp.pos), "player_after_R": str(game.player.position), "apart_px": snappedf(apart, 0.01), "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
	check("restart-mid-puff", after_r and apart > 100.0 and rp.moved == 0 and all_finished(rp) and on_time(rp), t)

	# --- A-R2 (DYING): into the street spike fire, Space during the 2.0 s hold, then the restart ---
	n = puffs.size()
	m = emits.size()
	game.player.position = Vector2(330, 310)   # in the spike fire at x 320-344 (as test_keyboard.gd)
	var died: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.DYING, 10)
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	var still_dying: bool = game.state == Game.State.DYING
	var back: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.PLAYING, 150)
	await steps(10)
	c = counts()
	c.merge({"died": died, "space_while_dying": still_dying, "restarted": back})
	check("none-while-dying", died and still_dying and back and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)

	# --- A-R2 (COMPLETE): entered through the session's own resolve_contacts, as test_keyboard.gd
	# does; finishing the real route would need both rescues ---
	n = puffs.size()
	m = emits.size()
	game.resolve_contacts(false, true)
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	await steps(10)
	check("none-when-complete", game.state == Game.State.COMPLETE and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, counts())

	# --- A-R1, A-R4, A-R5, A-R8 over the whole run ---
	var mismatched: Array = []
	var lives: Array = []
	for i in range(mini(emits.size(), puffs.size())):
		var ei: Dictionary = emits[i]
		var ri: Dictionary = puffs[i]
		lives.append(snappedf(life(ri), 0.0001))
		if ri.tick != ei.tick or ri.pos != ei.pos or ei.state != Game.State.PLAYING or not full(ri) or not all_finished(ri) or not on_time(ri):
			mismatched.append(i)
	check("every-jump-one-puff", emits.size() == puffs.size() and emits.size() > 0 and mismatched.is_empty() and puffs_in_tree() == 0,
		{"jumped": emits.size(), "puffs_added": puffs.size(), "mismatched": mismatched, "lives_s": lives, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s, "puffs_in_tree_at_end": puffs_in_tree()})
	var unsampled := puffs.filter(func(r): return r.samples == 0).size()
	check("always-behind-player", looked > 0 and unsampled == 0 and in_front == 0 and wrong_parent == 0,
		{"live_puff_samples": looked, "puffs_never_sampled": unsampled, "index_not_below_player": in_front, "not_child_of_level": wrong_parent, "player_index": game.player.get_index()})
	check("never-moved", looked > 0 and moved == 0, {"live_puff_samples": looked, "samples_moved": moved})
	finish()

func finish() -> void:
	print("JUMP PUFF STATE: %d checks / %d failures (physics tick %.6f s, frame %.6f s)" % [results.size(), failures, tick_s, frame_s])
	game.queue_free()
	await process_frame
	quit(1 if failures else 0)

213	func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
214		if state == State.DYING:
215			retry_remaining -= delta
216			if retry_remaining <= 0:
217				restart_attempt()
218		elif state == State.PLAYING:
219			elapsed += delta
220			var fell := player.position.y > float(level.fall_y)
221			var timed_out := elapsed >= float(level.time_limit)
222			var hit_fire := false
223			for hazard in hazard_areas:
224				if hazard.overlaps_body(player):
225					hit_fire = true
226			# The blocking fire is lethal + blocks the path until FULLY hosed. Its kill-zone
227			# shrinks from the top with the flames (see fire_height), but the base stays lethal
228			# until the fire is completely out -- so walking in mid-extinguish still kills.
229			if fire_active and level.has("blocking_fire"):
230				var bf0: Array = level.blocking_fire
231				var fire_top: float = (float(bf0[1]) + float(bf0[3])) - fire_height()
232				var half_w: float = Player.BOX.x / 2.0
233				if player.position.x + half_w > float(bf0[0]) and player.position.x - half_w < float(bf0[0]) + float(bf0[2]) and player.position.y > fire_top and player.position.y - Player.BOX.y < float(bf0[1]) + float(bf0[3]):
234					hit_fire = true
235			var fatal := fell or timed_out or hit_fire
236			if fatal:
237				death_reason = "Out of time!" if timed_out else ("You fell." if fell else "The fire got you.")
238			# Hose: tap W within range of the blocking fire -> water pours ~4 s -> fire out.
239			near_fire = false
240			if fire_active and level.has("blocking_fire"):
241				var bf: Array = level.blocking_fire
242				near_fire = player.is_on_floor() and player.position.x > float(bf[0]) - 50.0 and player.position.x < float(bf[0]) + float(bf[2]) + 10.0 and player.position.y < float(bf[1]) + float(bf[3]) + 20.0 and player.position.y > float(bf[1]) - 40.0
243				var water: bool = player.test_water_pressed if player.test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("water")
244				if player.test_control:
245					player.test_water_pressed = false
246				if water and near_fire and extinguish_ticks == 0:
247					extinguish_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS
248					water_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS + 60  # water lingers ~1 s after it is out
249					play_sfx("hose")
250			if extinguish_ticks > 0:
251				extinguish_ticks -= 1
252				if extinguish_ticks == 0:
253					fire_active = false
254			if water_ticks > 0:
255				water_ticks -= 1
256			player.hosing = water_ticks > 0
257			# Touch to rescue -- only while NOT in a fatal state, so you can't rescue THROUGH fire.
258			if not fatal:
259				for s in survivors:
260					if not s.rescued and s.area.overlaps_body(player):
261						s.rescued = true
262						s.area.set_deferred("monitoring", false)
263						rescued_count += 1
264						player.rescued = rescued_count
265						player.bag_types.append(s.type)
266						player.bag_in_flight += 1
267						player.play_actions([["grab", GRAB_TICKS], ["toss", TOSS_UP_TICKS]])
268						flights.append({"type": s.type, "from": Vector2(s.x, s.y), "t": 0})
269						play_sfx("rescue")
270						saved_popup_ticks = 55
271						saved_popup_pos = Vector2(s.x - 18.0, s.y - 34.0)
272			var all_rescued := rescued_count >= survivors.size()
273			var at_exit := goal.overlaps_body(player) and player.is_on_floor()
274			if at_exit and not all_rescued:
275				locked_cue_ticks = 45  # flash "rescue everyone first"
276			if locked_cue_ticks > 0:
277				locked_cue_ticks -= 1
278			if saved_popup_ticks > 0:
279				saved_popup_ticks -= 1
280			if contact_settle_ticks > 0:
281				contact_settle_ticks -= 1
282			else:
283				# Exit completes only when BOTH survivors are rescued AND reached on foot.
284				# State machine unchanged; only the COMPLETE condition gains "both rescued".
285				resolve_contacts(fatal, at_exit and all_rescued)
286			camera.position.x = clampf(player.position.x + 100, 320, float(level.width) - 320)
287		if state == State.COMPLETE:
288			complete_ticks += 1
289		for fl in flights:
290			fl.t += 1
291			if fl.t == GRAB_TICKS:  # toss starts: launch from his raised hand, straight up
292				fl.launch = player.position + Vector2(0.0, -62.0)
293				fl.apex = fl.launch + Vector2(0.0, -TOSS_HEIGHT)
294			if fl.t >= GRAB_TICKS + TOSS_UP_TICKS + TOSS_DOWN_TICKS:
295				player.bag_in_flight = maxi(player.bag_in_flight - 1, 0)
296				player.queue_redraw()
297		flights = flights.filter(func(fl): return fl.t < GRAB_TICKS + TOSS_UP_TICKS + TOSS_DOWN_TICKS)
298		if is_instance_valid(hud):
299			hud.queue_redraw()
300		queue_redraw()  # refresh the level's own dynamic draw: survivors vanish, SAVED! animates, exit unlocks

522	# so a missing sound leaves the game unchanged.
523	func _setup_audio() -> void:
524		for bus in ["Music", "SFX"]:
525			if AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus) == -1:
526				AudioServer.add_bus()
527				AudioServer.set_bus_name(AudioServer.bus_count - 1, bus)
528		for id in SFX_FILES:
529			var p := AudioStreamPlayer.new()
530			p.bus = "SFX"
531			var path := "res://audio/%s.ogg" % SFX_FILES[id]
532			if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
533				p.stream = load(path)
534			add_child(p)
535			sfx_players[id] = p
536			sfx_counts[id] = 0

552		var i := AudioServer.get_bus_index(bus)

570			State.DYING:

572			State.PAUSED:

	draw_set_transform(Vector2(c.x * f, c.y), 0.0, Vector2(2.0, 2.0))
	var ink := Color("1b2a3f")      # outline
	var skin := Color("e8b98f")     # face
	var bag_col := Color("e67e22")  # orange rescue duffel
	var bag_dark := Color("b8621b") # bag seam
	draw_rect(Rect2(-4.5, -4.5, 9, 9), ink)
	draw_rect(Rect2(-3.5, -3.5, 7, 7), bag_col)

			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy + 0.5), 0.9, ink)  # snout/eye
		else:

			draw_circle(Vector2(hx + 1.2 * f, hyy), 0.8, ink)        # eye

# through session.resolve_contacts(false, true), and sets the tree pause (the game never does).
# Run: scripts/run-test.sh test_jump_puff_state.gd 60
# What this cannot see: pixels or particle positions. Headless Godot draws nothing (CLAUDE.md,
# Headless facts); the look, the draw order on screen and the frozen frame are eye checks.
const Main = preload("res://game/main.tscn")
const Game = preload("res://game/session.gd")
const PUFF_PATH := "res://effects/jump_puff.tscn"
const KIDS := ["Flash:CPUParticles2D", "Puff:CPUParticles2D", "Specks:CPUParticles2D"]
const LIFE := 0.9      # A-R5: freed within 0.9 s (+ one frame) of its jump; the Puff layer's lifetime
const EPS := 1e-6
const SPAWN := Vector2(64, 320)
var game: Node2D
var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
var failures := 0
var tick_s := 0.0      # one physics tick in seconds
var frame_s := 0.0     # one drawn frame in seconds: the "one frame" of A-R5
var emits: Array = []  # per player.jumped, in order: {tick, pos, state, live_after}
var puffs: Array = []  # per JumpPuff added, in order: {node, id, tick, pos, parent, kids, emitting, finished, freed_tick, freed_state, samples, moved, max_dist}
var seen_emits := 0
var tree_pauses: Array = []  # [from_tick, to_tick] of each tree pause the test made
var max_live := 0
var looked := 0        # live-puff samples taken (once per live puff per frame)
var moved := 0         # samples where a live puff's root was not where it was made (A-R4)
var wrong_parent := 0  # samples where a live puff was not a child of WalkerJumpman (A-R6)
var in_front := 0      # samples where a live puff's index was not below the player's (A-R8)

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func tick() -> int:
	return Engine.get_physics_frames()

# One frame, then one look at every live puff (after this frame's physics, before its _process).
func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame
		sample()

# Synthetic key event through Godot Input, as test_keyboard.gd and test_hose_glow.gd.
func key(code: Key, pressed: bool) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func tap(code: Key) -> void:
	key(code, true)
	await steps(2)
	key(code, false)
	await steps(1)

func wait_for(cond: Callable, limit: int) -> bool:
	var n := 0
	while n < limit and not cond.call():
		await steps(1)
		n += 1
	return cond.call()

# One real jump: Space down until the jump is seen (at most 10 frames), then up.
func jump() -> bool:
	var n := emits.size()
	key(KEY_SPACE, true)
	await wait_for(func(): return emits.size() > n, 10)
	key(KEY_SPACE, false)
	await steps(1)
	return emits.size() == n + 1

# Space as he falls the last 12 px to where he jumped from: inside the 6-tick jump buffer, so the
# next jump starts on the landing tick (CHANGE-BRIEF "Jump timing"), 0.8 s after the last.
func jump_on_landing() -> bool:
	var from_y: float = emits.back().pos.y
	await wait_for(func(): return game.player.velocity.y > 0.0 and game.player.position.y >= from_y - 12.0, 90)
	return await jump()

func check(id: String, condition: bool, observed: Dictionary) -> void:
	results.append({"id": id, "status": "PASS" if condition else "FAIL", "observed": observed})
	print(JSON.stringify(results.back()))
	if not condition:
		failures += 1

# --- watchers: they read, never write ---

func _on_node_added(node: Node) -> void:
	if node.scene_file_path != PUFF_PATH:
		return
	var rec := {"node": node, "id": node.get_instance_id(), "tick": tick(), "pos": node.global_position,
		"parent": node.get_parent(), "kids": [], "emitting": [], "finished": {}, "freed_tick": -1,
		"freed_state": -1, "samples": 0, "moved": 0, "max_dist": 0.0}
	for c in node.get_children():
		rec.kids.append("%s:%s" % [c.name, c.get_class()])
		rec.emitting.append(c.emitting)
		c.finished.connect(_on_emitter_finished.bind(rec, String(c.name)))
	node.tree_exited.connect(_on_puff_exited.bind(rec))
	puffs.append(rec)

func _on_emitter_finished(rec: Dictionary, emitter: String) -> void:
	rec.finished[emitter] = tick()

func _on_puff_exited(rec: Dictionary) -> void:
	rec.freed_tick = tick()
	rec.freed_state = game.state if is_instance_valid(game) else -1

func _on_jumped() -> void:
	emits.append({"tick": tick(), "pos": game.player.global_position, "state": game.state, "live_after": -1})

func live() -> Array:
	return puffs.filter(func(r): return r.freed_tick < 0)

func sample() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(game):
		return
	var alive := live()
	max_live = maxi(max_live, alive.size())
	if seen_emits < emits.size():
		emits.back().live_after = alive.size()   # puffs alive at the end of the jump's physics tick
		seen_emits = emits.size()
	var player_index: int = game.player.get_index()
	for rec in alive:
		var node: Node2D = rec.node
		looked += 1
		rec.samples += 1
		rec.max_dist = maxf(rec.max_dist, node.global_position.distance_to(game.player.global_position))
		if node.global_position != rec.pos:
			moved += 1
			rec.moved += 1
		if node.get_parent() != game:
			wrong_parent += 1
		if node.get_index() >= player_index:
			in_front += 1

func puffs_in_tree() -> int:
	var n := 0
	for node in root.find_children("*", "", true, false):
		if node.scene_file_path == PUFF_PATH:
			n += 1
	return n

# Seconds of unpaused game time from its jump to its free (tree pauses the test made are taken out).
func life(rec: Dictionary) -> float:
	var ticks: int = rec.freed_tick - rec.tick
	for p in tree_pauses:
		ticks -= maxi(0, mini(rec.freed_tick, p[1]) - maxi(rec.tick, p[0]))
	return ticks * tick_s

# A-R5: within LIFE plus one frame; and not before LIFE minus one frame (not cut off).
func on_time(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var l := life(rec)
	return rec.freed_tick >= 0 and l <= LIFE + frame_s + EPS and l >= LIFE - frame_s - EPS

# A-R5: all three emitters finished, and the puff was freed in the frame the last one did.
func all_finished(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
	if rec.finished.size() != KIDS.size():
		return false
	var last := -1
	for t in rec.finished.values():
		last = maxi(last, t)
	return rec.freed_tick == last

# A-R3 "full puff": the scene's three emitters, all emitting when it was added.
func full(rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
	return rec.kids == KIDS and rec.emitting == [true, true, true]

func timings(rec: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	var out := {}
	for k in rec.finished:
		out[k] = snappedf((rec.finished[k] - rec.tick) * tick_s, 0.0001)
	return {"finished_after_s": out, "freed_after_s": snappedf(life(rec), 0.0001), "freed_with_last_finished": all_finished(rec)}

func counts() -> Dictionary:
	return {"state": game.state, "jumped": emits.size(), "puffs_added": puffs.size(), "puffs_in_tree": puffs_in_tree()}

func run() -> void:
	node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
	tick_s = 1.0 / Engine.physics_ticks_per_second
	game = Main.instantiate()
	game.test_mode = true
	root.add_child(game)
	game.player.jumped.connect(_on_jumped)
	await steps(30)
	frame_s = root.get_process_delta_time()

	# --- A-R2: nothing on scene load, in MENU, or on start ---
	check("none-on-load", game.state == Game.State.MENU and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty() and puffs_in_tree() == 0, counts())
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	await steps(10)
	check("none-in-menu", game.state == Game.State.MENU and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty(), counts())
	await tap(KEY_ENTER)
	await steps(10)
	check("none-on-start", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and game.player.is_on_floor() and puffs.is_empty() and emits.is_empty(), counts())

	# --- A-R1, A-R4, A-R5, A-R6 and landing: one real jump with D held, so he moves away from it ---
	key(KEY_D, true)
	var jumped: bool = await jump()
	await steps(12)
	key(KEY_D, false)
	var landed: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
	await steps(3)
	check("none-on-landing", jumped and landed and emits.size() == 1 and puffs.size() == 1, counts())
	await wait_for(func(): return live().is_empty(), 90)
	if emits.size() != 1 or puffs.size() != 1:
		check("one-puff-at-feet", false, counts())
		return finish()
	var e: Dictionary = emits[0]
	var p: Dictionary = puffs[0]
	check("one-puff-at-feet", p.tick == e.tick and p.pos == e.pos and e.state == Game.State.PLAYING,
		{"jump_tick": e.tick, "puff_tick": p.tick, "player_at_jump": str(e.pos), "puff_at": str(p.pos), "state_at_jump": e.state})
	check("parent-is-level", p.parent == game and p.parent != game.player and full(p),
		{"parent": str(p.parent.name) if is_instance_valid(p.parent) else "", "children": p.kids, "emitting_when_added": p.emitting})
	check("stays-put", p.samples > 0 and p.moved == 0 and p.max_dist >= 30.0,
		{"frames_sampled": p.samples, "frames_moved": p.moved, "player_max_distance_px": snappedf(p.max_dist, 0.01), "puff_at": str(p.pos)})
	var t := timings(p)
	t.merge({"expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s, "puffs_in_tree": puffs_in_tree()})
	check("frees-when-finished", all_finished(p) and on_time(p) and puffs_in_tree() == 0, t)

	# --- A-R3 overlap: four jumps, each Space just before he lands, so each jump starts 0.8 s after
	# the last on flat ground, inside one 0.9 s puff life ---
	await steps(10)
	max_live = 0
	var i1 := emits.size()
	var chain_ok: bool = await jump()
	for k in range(3):
		if not await jump_on_landing():
			chain_ok = false
	await wait_for(func(): return live().is_empty(), 90)
	if not chain_ok or emits.size() < i1 + 4 or puffs.size() < i1 + 4:
		check("retrigger-overlap", false, counts())
		return finish()
	var gaps: Array = []
	for k in range(i1 + 1, i1 + 4):
		gaps.append(snappedf((emits[k].tick - emits[k - 1].tick) * tick_s, 0.0001))
	var e1: Dictionary = emits[i1]
	var e2: Dictionary = emits[i1 + 1]
	var p1: Dictionary = puffs[i1]
	var p2: Dictionary = puffs[i1 + 1]
	var gap: float = (e2.tick - e1.tick) * tick_s
	check("retrigger-overlap", gap < LIFE and e2.live_after == 2 and p1.freed_tick > e2.tick and p1.finished.get("Puff", -1) > e2.tick and p2.id != p1.id and p2.tick == e2.tick and p2.pos == e2.pos and full(p2),
		{"jump_gap_s": gap, "live_at_jump_2": e2.live_after, "first_freed_after_jump_2_s": (p1.freed_tick - e2.tick) * tick_s, "first_puff_layer_running_at_jump_2": p1.finished.get("Puff", -1) > e2.tick, "second_is_new_instance": p2.id != p1.id, "second_full": full(p2), "second_at": str(p2.pos), "player_at_jump_2": str(e2.pos)})
	var t1 := timings(p1)
	var t2 := timings(p2)
	check("first-not-restarted", all_finished(p1) and on_time(p1) and all_finished(p2) and on_time(p2),
		{"first": t1, "second": t2, "first_if_restarted_at_jump_2_s": gap + LIFE, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
	check("max-two-alive", max_live == 2, {"jumps": 4, "jump_gaps_s": gaps, "max_live": max_live})

	# --- A-R2: walking off a ledge is a fall, not a jump ---
	var n := puffs.size()
	var m := emits.size()
	game.player.position = Vector2(600, 288)   # on the block at x 576-624, top y 288 (first_steps.json)
	await steps(5)
	var on_block: bool = game.player.is_on_floor()
	key(KEY_D, true)
	var left_floor: bool = await wait_for(func(): return not game.player.is_on_floor(), 60)
	var air_from := tick()
	var landed_below: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 60)
	var air_ticks := tick() - air_from
	key(KEY_D, false)
	await steps(10)
	var c := counts()
	c.merge({"on_block": on_block, "left_floor": left_floor, "air_ticks": air_ticks, "landed_at": str(game.player.position)})
	check("none-on-walk-off", on_block and left_floor and landed_below and air_ticks >= 5 and game.player.position.y > 300.0 and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)

	# --- A-R2 (PAUSED) and A-R7 (Esc): Esc right after a jump; Space while paused adds nothing; the
	# puff in flight finishes on time while the game stays paused (Esc doesn't pause the tree) ---
	await jump()
	var pp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
	await tap(KEY_ESCAPE)
	var esc_paused: bool = game.state == Game.State.PAUSED
	n = puffs.size()
	m = emits.size()
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	await steps(5)
	check("none-while-paused", esc_paused and game.state == Game.State.PAUSED and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, counts())
	await wait_for(func(): return pp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
	t = timings(pp)
	t.merge({"state_when_freed": pp.freed_state, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
	check("game-pause-puff-finishes", pp.freed_state == Game.State.PAUSED and all_finished(pp) and on_time(pp), t)
	await tap(KEY_ENTER)
	await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
	await steps(5)

	# --- A-R7 (tree): 0.3 s after a jump the tree is paused for 1.5 s: the puff is not freed, not
	# moved and still visible, and no emitter finishes; afterwards it finishes 0.9 s of unpaused
	# game time after its jump ---
	await jump()
	var tp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
	await wait_for(func(): return tick() - tp.tick >= 18, 30)
	var finished_before: int = tp.finished.size()
	var player_at: Vector2 = game.player.position
	paused = true
	var from := tick()
	await steps(90)
	var held: bool = tp.freed_tick < 0 and is_instance_valid(tp.node) and tp.node.is_inside_tree() and tp.node.is_visible_in_tree() and tp.node.global_position == tp.pos and tp.finished.size() == finished_before and game.player.position == player_at
	var finished_during: int = tp.finished.size() - finished_before
	paused = false
	tree_pauses.append([from, tick()])
	check("tree-pause-freezes", held,
		{"paused_s": (tick() - from) * tick_s, "paused_at_s_after_jump": (from - tp.tick) * tick_s, "freed": tp.freed_tick >= 0, "visible": tp.node.is_visible_in_tree() if is_instance_valid(tp.node) else false, "emitters_finished_before_pause": finished_before, "emitters_finished_while_paused": finished_during, "player_moved": game.player.position != player_at})
	await wait_for(func(): return tp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
	t = timings(tp)
	t.merge({"wall_s_including_pause": (tp.freed_tick - tp.tick) * tick_s, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
	check("tree-pause-resumes", all_finished(tp) and on_time(tp), t)
	await wait_for(func(): return game.player.is_on_floor(), 90)
	await steps(5)

	# --- A-R2 (R) and A-R6: R 0.2 s after a jump away from the spawn point; no new puff, and the puff
	# in flight stays in the level where it was made and finishes on time ---
	await jump()
	var rp: Dictionary = puffs.back()
	await wait_for(func(): return tick() - rp.tick >= 12, 30)
	n = puffs.size()
	m = emits.size()
	await tap(KEY_R)
	var at_spawn: bool = game.player.position.distance_to(SPAWN) < 1.0
	c = counts()
	c.merge({"player_at": str(game.player.position)})
	check("none-on-restart", game.state == Game.State.PLAYING and at_spawn and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)
	var after_r: bool = rp.freed_tick < 0 and rp.node.get_parent() == game and rp.node.global_position == rp.pos
	var apart: float = rp.pos.distance_to(game.player.global_position)
	await wait_for(func(): return rp.freed_tick >= 0, 90)
	t = timings(rp)
	t.merge({"alive_in_level_after_R": after_r, "puff_at": str(rp.pos), "player_after_R": str(game.player.position), "apart_px": snappedf(apart, 0.01), "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s})
	check("restart-mid-puff", after_r and apart > 100.0 and rp.moved == 0 and all_finished(rp) and on_time(rp), t)

	# --- A-R2 (DYING): into the street spike fire, Space during the 2.0 s hold, then the restart ---
	n = puffs.size()
	m = emits.size()
	game.player.position = Vector2(330, 310)   # in the spike fire at x 320-344 (as test_keyboard.gd)
	var died: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.DYING, 10)
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	var still_dying: bool = game.state == Game.State.DYING
	var back: bool = await wait_for(func(): return game.state == Game.State.PLAYING, 150)
	await steps(10)
	c = counts()
	c.merge({"died": died, "space_while_dying": still_dying, "restarted": back})
	check("none-while-dying", died and still_dying and back and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, c)

	# --- A-R2 (COMPLETE): entered through the session's own resolve_contacts, as test_keyboard.gd
	# does; finishing the real route would need both rescues ---
	n = puffs.size()
	m = emits.size()
	game.resolve_contacts(false, true)
	await tap(KEY_SPACE)
	await steps(10)
	check("none-when-complete", game.state == Game.State.COMPLETE and puffs.size() == n and emits.size() == m, counts())

	# --- A-R1, A-R4, A-R5, A-R8 over the whole run ---
	var mismatched: Array = []
	var lives: Array = []
	for i in range(mini(emits.size(), puffs.size())):
		var ei: Dictionary = emits[i]
		var ri: Dictionary = puffs[i]
		lives.append(snappedf(life(ri), 0.0001))
		if ri.tick != ei.tick or ri.pos != ei.pos or ei.state != Game.State.PLAYING or not full(ri) or not all_finished(ri) or not on_time(ri):
			mismatched.append(i)
	check("every-jump-one-puff", emits.size() == puffs.size() and emits.size() > 0 and mismatched.is_empty() and puffs_in_tree() == 0,
		{"jumped": emits.size(), "puffs_added": puffs.size(), "mismatched": mismatched, "lives_s": lives, "expected_s": LIFE, "tolerance_s": frame_s, "puffs_in_tree_at_end": puffs_in_tree()})
	var unsampled := puffs.filter(func(r): return r.samples == 0).size()
	check("always-behind-player", looked > 0 and unsampled == 0 and in_front == 0 and wrong_parent == 0,
		{"live_puff_samples": looked, "puffs_never_sampled": unsampled, "index_not_below_player": in_front, "not_child_of_level": wrong_parent, "player_index": game.player.get_index()})
	check("never-moved", looked > 0 and moved == 0, {"live_puff_samples": looked, "samples_moved": moved})
	finish()

func finish() -> void:
	print("JUMP PUFF STATE: %d checks / %d failures (physics tick %.6f s, frame %.6f s)" % [results.size(), failures, tick_s, frame_s])
	game.queue_free()
	await process_frame
	quit(1 if failures else 0)

There is no AGENTS.md in this repository.

## Project context

- **Engine:** Godot 4.7.2 stable. `godot/project.godot` declares `config/features=PackedStringArray("4.7", "GL Compatibility")`; every log in `logs/` starts `Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf`.
- **Renderer:** GL Compatibility. `godot/project.godot` `[rendering]` sets `renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"` and `renderer/rendering_method.mobile="gl_compatibility"`; no `hdr_2d` key. The brief rules out particle trails and 2D particle collision under it (CHANGE-BRIEF.md "What limits the choices").
- **Viewport:** 640 × 360, window 1280 × 720, stretch `canvas_items` (`godot/project.godot` `[display]`).
- **Effect node types** (CHANGE-BRIEF.md A3, B3; neither scene exists yet):
  - Jump puff: `godot/effects/jump_puff.tscn`, `Node2D` root `JumpPuff` with three `CPUParticles2D` children `Flash`, `Puff`, `Specks`, all `one_shot`.
  - Hose steam: `godot/effects/hose_steam.tscn`, `Node2D` root `HoseSteam` with two `GPUParticles2D` children `Haze` (drawn first) and `Steam`, each with a `ParticleProcessMaterial`.
  - Both draw a `GradientTexture2D` defined inside the scene; no image file, no draw material (mix blend).
- **Jump puff event, signal `jumped`:** declared at the top of `godot/features/player/player.gd`, emitted in its `_physics_process` after `velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity` and before `move_and_slide()`. `_physics_process` returns at once while `enabled` is false. `godot/game/session.gd` sets `player.enabled = false` in `set_paused()`, in `resolve_contacts()` (DYING, COMPLETE) and in the `menu` handler, so `jumped` fires only in PLAYING. The player's origin is his feet (`player.gd`: `BOX` comment; collider at `(0, -BOX.y / 2)`). `session.gd` `_ready()` already connects `player.jumped` to `play_sfx("jump")`.
- **Hose steam condition, `player.hosing`:** `var hosing` in `player.gd`. `session.gd` `_physics_process` writes `player.hosing = water_ticks > 0` inside the PLAYING branch only, so the value holds through PAUSED and DYING. A W press in range sets `extinguish_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS` (240) and `water_ticks = EXTINGUISH_TICKS + 60`. `restart_attempt()` runs from `start_session()`, from the R handler in `_unhandled_input` and from the DYING timeout. It zeroes both counters and calls `player.reset_at()`, which sets `hosing = false` at once.

It holds one `Node2D` `WalkerJumpman` with `godot/game/session.gd`, whose `_ready()` builds everything in code: solids, hazard areas, `Player.new()`, `Camera2D`, a background `CanvasLayer` (layer −1) and a HUD `CanvasLayer`. `session.gd` `_draw()` draws the buildings, fires and water stream on `WalkerJumpman` itself. The puff's root becomes a child of `WalkerJumpman`, not of the player (CHANGE-BRIEF.md A-R6). The steam root's position is given in level coordinates (B-R4).
- **Previews (to be made):** `godot/previews/jump_puff_preview.tscn` and `godot/previews/hose_steam_preview.tscn`, both over the real B1 art and captured as 30 fps strips (CHANGE-BRIEF.md A5, B5).
- **A5 driver pattern:** `godot/features/player/hose_glow.gd` is a `Node` that `player.gd` `_ready()` adds as a child. It reads `hosing` in `_process` and writes one shader parameter. `godot/tests/test_hose_glow.gd` tests it with real key events.
- **Tests (`godot/tests/`, all `extends SceneTree`):** `_initialize()` defers to `run()`, and `steps(n)` awaits `physics_frame` plus `process_frame`.
  - `test_game.gd` (41 checks) drives the player through its hooks `test_control`, `test_axis`, `test_jump_pressed`, `test_jump_held` and `test_water_pressed`.
  - `test_keyboard.gd` (14) and `test_hose_glow.gd` (15) send `InputEventKey`s via `Input.parse_input_event`.
  - Also `test_audio.gd` (14), `test_materials.gd` (35) and `check_props.gd` (`RESULT: PASS`). Each one calls `quit(1)` on any failure.
  - Other scripts in the folder: `route_driver.gd` (scripted route), `normal_map_check.gd` (helper for `test_materials.gd`), `calibrate_normal_maps.gd`, `write_grey_strip.gd`, the windowed `capture_*.gd`, `run_check_props.sh` (A3 runner).

It tees to `logs/<name>_<fps>fps.log` or `logs/<name>_realtime.log`. The exit status is Godot's (124 = hung), or 1 if the log has a `SHADER ERROR` / `SCRIPT ERROR` line. `realtime` drops `--fixed-fps`. It calls `godot` from PATH (on this Mac a local shim; commit `78d926e`) and forwards no other arguments.

  scripts/run-test.sh test_keyboard.gd 60        # 14/14
  scripts/run-test.sh test_audio.gd 60           # 12/14 (see below)
  scripts/run-test.sh test_audio.gd realtime 300 # 14/14 (138 s; times out at the default 120)

## Headless facts

What a `scripts/run-test.sh` run on this machine can and cannot observe. Probes and logs: `a6/evidence/probes/`.

- A headless run uses a dummy renderer: it draws no particles and runs no GPU particle process. Node state (emitting, one_shot, amount_ratio, visibility, instance counts) is observable; the look is not.
- A GPU effect's headless CPU price is near zero by construction.
- Frame strips come from a windowed Movie Maker run, which I start.
- Measured here (`particle_cost_example09_60fps.log`, Apple M1, `--fixed-fps 60`): `GPUParticles2D` at 1,000 to 50,000 particles costs the same as the empty scene (about 0.004 ms per frame); `CPUParticles2D` costs about 0.055 ms per 1,000 particles and grows with the count. Without `--fixed-fps` every case reads the same ~6.9 ms sleep (Chapter 9).
- `RenderingServer.get_current_rendering_method()` still reports `gl_compatibility` headless; the empty `get_video_adapter_name()` is the sign that nothing renders (`headless_probe_60fps.log`).
- A one-shot `CPUParticles2D` simulates headless and emits `finished`; a one-shot `GPUParticles2D` never emits `finished` headless, though `emitting` goes false (`headless_probe_60fps.log`). A test may wait on the CPU puff's `finished`, never on the GPU steam's.
- `amount_ratio` is set and read back headless; `amount` is unchanged by it.
- No pixel can be read headless. Every claim about the look is an eye or frame-strip check (CHANGE-BRIEF.md "Evidence split").
- `--fixed-fps N` pins each frame to 1/N s of game time; physics stays at 60 ticks per second, so at 30 fps each frame runs two physics ticks (a5/TEST-REPORT.md: the 300-tick hold took 152 frames at 30 fps).
- Real input works headless: `Input.parse_input_event()` with `InputEventKey` (`test_keyboard.gd`, `test_hose_glow.gd`) and the player's `test_*` hooks (`test_game.gd`).
- `test_audio.gd` needs `realtime`, and its last check waits for the 25.6 s music loop, so it also needs the timeout argument (`realtime 300`, 138 s); at the default 120 s it stops at 13/14 with exit 124.
- A5 shader facts still hold: `Shader.get_shader_uniform_list()` works headless and is empty for a shader that failed to parse; a `set_shader_parameter()` / `get_shader_parameter()` round trip proves nothing.
